radiator: Standard Civic radiator, dedicated EV coolant loop with fan and shroud assumed
assumptions: All UA, efficiency, internal thermal resistance and heat-capacity values are engineering sensitivity assumptions, not measured Civic or Prius properties
All motor loss assigned to winding node, conservatively; rotor/magnet hotspots are not resolved
All gear and inverter losses enter the same coolant heat budget
Radiator UA is coolant-mean to inlet-air conductance; low airflow is not inferred from road speed alone
Cooling plumbing provides the stated motor-to-coolant thermal paths; stock engine-driven lubrication may change after modification
Limits are planning targets, not allowable hardware settings
